text:
Sea's total revenue grew faster in FY2025 than in FY2024.

- FY2024 total revenue was US$16,819,866 thousand, up ~28.8% from US$13,063,560 thousand in FY2023 [Sea, FY2024, p.91].
- FY2025 total revenue was US$22,938,469 thousand, up ~36.4% from US$16,819,866 thousand in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.95].

So the growth rate accelerated from about 28.8% in FY2024 to about 36.4% in FY2025, meaning FY2025 saw faster revenue growth.

answer:

- FY2025 total revenue was US$22,938,469 thousand, up ~36.4% from US$16,819,866 thousand in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.95].
